items.event_time_ist: early morning ET, Oct 12, 2026 (approx. 3:30–5:30 PM IST)
items.summary: Homeland Security Investigations agents executed a judicially authorized search warrant at Rep. Ilhan Omar's Washington, D.C. home early Monday, carrying out boxes of evidence; the DOJ confirmed it is part of an ongoing federal criminal investigation. Per NY Post sources, the years-long probe — involving whistleblowers — centers on alleged false statements in the Somalia-born congresswoman's immigration paperwork, possibly tied to her late father's citizenship application; no charges have been filed. Omar called it 'an attempt to target political enemies and weaponize federal law enforcement,' vowing she 'will not be silenced.' House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries called the raid 'deeply disturbing'; Rep. Rashida Tlaib called it 'what a fascist police state does.' President Trump said he had 'nothing' to do with ordering it: 'I think she's a terrible person, but that's really up to the DOJ.'
items.title: DHS agents raid Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home in immigration-fraud probe

items.summary: After the first days of early voting in Ohio, Democrats are showing unexpected strength in the state's most Republican counties, per Ohio Secretary of State data and Catalist analysis. In counties that voted for Trump by 20+ points in 2024, Republicans' 30-point lead in early voter shares has shrunk to 5 points; in the three most pro-Trump counties, the ballot-return partisan breakdown has shifted nearly 11 points toward Democrats vs. this point in 2024. The overall early electorate is ~27 points more Democratic than at the same point in 2024. Turnout pace: Harris counties at 74% of their 2024 pace, Trump counties at 67%. Separately, Signal Ohio reports early in-person voting is surging statewide while mail voting collapses: 20,030 early in-person ballots on day one across 56 counties vs. 8,647 four years ago (Cuyahoga County 1,908 vs. 547); mail voting is at just 25% of its 2024 pace, with Franklin County mail requests down to ~70,000 from 90,000+ in 2018/2022. A CNN poll also found Sherrod Brown leading Jon Husted by 6 points in the Ohio Senate race.
items.title: CNN: Democrats overperforming in early voting in Ohio's most Trump-friendly counties

items.event_time_ist: 2:49 PM EDT, Oct 13, 2026 (12:19 AM IST, Oct 14)
items.summary: Monroe County, Indiana (Bloomington) logged 2,686 early ballots in the first five days — more than 2% of registered voters — higher than any midterm since 2006 except 2018's record (3,933 in the same window), per the county's live early-voting dashboard. Indiana polls opened 28 days before Election Day. Indiana Public Media cites the Iran war, rising oil prices and Trump's domestic agenda as drivers; the state's restrictive voting hours and mail-ballot limits may still depress overall turnout.
items.title: Monroe County, Indiana: early voting turnout beats every midterm since 2006 except 2018
